meta.title: Suggested Action used instead of a typed prompt

steps.note: Open the multi-stage create screen for a technical event.
Configure the event with a Technical/RFP stage.
Move to the technical stage where the RFP Generator operates.
Apply a technical template so the RFP question area is available.
Provide a line item for the Line Items section and AI-generated questions.
Open the RFP Generator AI chat panel.

args.goal: in the open RFP Generator AI chat panel, choose either the Vendor Assessments or Line Items section, click one of its Suggested Actions, send it, and stop when the chosen section visibly shows changed questions

steps.note: Perform the Suggested Action interaction and verify on screen that the selected section's questions changed.
Confirm the interaction completed without an application error.
